For a function $f(t)$ defined on $[0,\infty ),$ the Laplace transform of $f,$ denoted $L{f(t)}$ or $F(s),$ is a function of the variable $s$ defined as

$$
F(s)=L{f(t)}={\int }_{0}^{\infty }{e}^{-st}f(t)\,\text{d}t
$$

provided that this integral exists and is finite. 

For the function $f(t)=-\frac{7}{3},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(s)={\int }_{0}^{\infty }-\frac{7}{3}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t.\end{aligned}
$$

We calculate our integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}F(s) & ={\int }_{0}^{\infty }-\frac{7}{3}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t \\  & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{0}^{a}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t\end{aligned}
$$

To evaluate the last integral, we must consider whether $s\ne 0$ or $s=0.$

- If $s\ne 0,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(s) & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{0}^{a}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t \\  & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }{(-\frac{1}{s}{e}^{-st})|}_{0}^{a} \\  & =\frac{7}{3s}({lim}_{a\to \infty }{e}^{-sa}-1).\end{aligned}
$$

Let's evaluate the limit. We have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{a\to \infty }{e}^{-sa}={\begin{aligned}0,\, & s>0, \\ \infty ,\, & s<0.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

- If $s=0,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(0) & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{0}^{a}{e}^{-0t}\text{d}t \\  & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }{\int }_{0}^{a}\text{d}t \\  & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }t\,{|}_{0}^{a} \\  & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }(a-0) \\  & =-\frac{7}{3}{lim}_{a\to \infty }a \\  & =-\infty .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore:

- For $s<0,$ we have that ${\int }_{0}^{\infty }-\frac{7}{3}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t\,\text{is divergent}$

- For $s>0,$ we have that ${\int }_{{}_{0}}^{\infty }-\frac{7}{3}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t\,\text{is convergent}$

- For $s=0,$ we have that ${\int }_{0}^{\infty }-\frac{7}{3}{e}^{-st}\text{d}t\,\text{is divergent}$

Evaluating our integral for $s>0,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(s) & =\frac{7}{3s}({lim}_{a\to \infty }{e}^{-sa}-1) \\  & =\frac{7}{3s}(0-1) \\  & =-\frac{7}{3s}.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the Laplace transform of $f(t)=-\frac{7}{3}$ is $F(s)=-\frac{7}{3s},$ defined for $s>0.$
